Definition: middle voice from G1435; to bestow gratuitously:--give.
BiblicalUsage: To give freely, to bestow, the verb of God's giving, used when Pilate gave the body of Jesus to Joseph, and when Peter says God's divine power has given us all things that pertain to life and godliness. The promises by which we partake of the divine nature are given, not earned.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gives all things for life and godliness before I ask for any of them, and the gift is already in my hands. My part is to add to my faith the virtues that grow from what He has already bestowed.
